domain_entities.name: LeaveRequest
domain_entities.purpose: Represents an employee's request for leave. Owned by the requesting employee; acted upon by their manager. Tracks the full lifecycle from draft through final resolution.
lifecycle_states: DRAFT — initial state; request is being prepared by the employee; only the owner can modify or cancel
SUBMITTED — employee has submitted for manager review; immutable by employee except for withdrawal; visible to manager
APPROVED — manager has approved the request; leave days are deducted from the employee's balance; terminal state (unless revoked)
REJECTED — manager has rejected the request; no balance impact; terminal state
CANCELLED — request is voided; can be reached from DRAFT (owner cancels), SUBMITTED (owner withdraws), or APPROVED (manager revokes); any deducted balance is restored if previously approved

domain_entities.name: LeavePolicy
domain_entities.purpose: Defines the rules and entitlements for a specific leave type. Acts as the template from which employee balances are derived. Enforces constraints like minimum notice, accrual caps, and whether manager approval is required.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE — policy is in effect; governs leave requests and balance calculations
INACTIVE — policy is disabled; no new requests can be created under it; existing balances remain but cannot be used

domain_entities.name: Employee
domain_entities.purpose: Represents an employee in the organization. Owns leave requests and leave balances. The managerId establishes the approval hierarchy for leave requests.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE — employee is currently employed; can submit leave requests and accrue balances
INACTIVE — employee is on extended leave or suspension; cannot submit new leave requests; existing balances are frozen
TERMINATED — employment has ended; all balances are void; no further leave actions permitted

domain_entities.name: LeaveBalance
domain_entities.purpose: Tracks an employee's leave entitlement, usage, and remaining days for a specific leave policy within a fiscal year. Deducted when a leave request is approved; restored if an approved request is cancelled/revoked.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE — balance is in effect for the current fiscal year; used for leave request validation and deduction
EXHAUSTED — remainingDays has reached zero; no further leave of this type can be taken until the next fiscal year or accrual replenishes it
FROZEN — balance is temporarily suspended (e.g., employee on long-term leave, policy deactivated); no deductions or requests allowed
CLOSED — fiscal year has ended; balance is archived; a new balance is created for the next fiscal year

domain_entities.name: LeaveType
domain_entities.purpose: Categorizes the kind of leave being requested. Each type maps to a LeavePolicy that governs its rules. The feature scope covers annual, sick, and emergency; unpaid, maternity, and paternity are defined for completeness.

domain_entities.name: LeaveStatus
domain_entities.purpose: Enumerates the lifecycle states of a LeaveRequest. Drives state-transition validation and determines which actions are permissible at each stage.

domain_entities.name: AuditLog
domain_entities.purpose: Immutable record of every state-changing operation in the leave management domain. Required by GP-002. Captures what changed, who changed it, and when. Actions include CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, APPROVE, REJECT.

business_rules: BR-001 — State Transition Enforcement: A LeaveRequest may only transition along these paths: DRAFT→SUBMITTED, DRAFT→CANCELLED, SUBMITTED→APPROVED, SUBMITTED→REJECTED, SUBMITTED→CANCELLED (withdrawal), APPROVED→CANCELLED (revocation). No other transitions are valid. Attempting an invalid transition must be rejected.

BR-002 — Balance Sufficiency Check: Before a LeaveRequest can transition from SUBMITTED to APPROVED, the employee's LeaveBalance for the corresponding policy and fiscal year must have remainingDays >= the number of working days in the requested date range. If the leave type is 'unpaid', this check is skipped.

BR-003 — Balance Deduction on Approval: When a LeaveRequest transitions to APPROVED, the corresponding LeaveBalance.usedDays is incremented by the number of working days in the request, and remainingDays is recalculated (totalEntitlement - usedDays). The balance status transitions to EXHAUSTED if remainingDays reaches zero.

BR-004 — Balance Restoration on Revocation: When an APPROVED LeaveRequest transitions to CANCELLED, the previously deducted days are restored to the LeaveBalance: usedDays is decremented and remainingDays is recalculated. If the balance was EXHAUSTED, it returns to ACTIVE.

BR-005 — Manager Approval Authority: Only the employee's designated manager (Employee.managerId) may approve or reject a SUBMITTED LeaveRequest. If the employee has no manager (managerId is null), the request is auto-approved (unless the policy explicitly requires manager approval). The approvedBy field is set to the manager's employeeId upon approval.

BR-006 — Active Employee Constraint: Only employees with employmentStatus = 'ACTIVE' may create or submit a LeaveRequest. Employees with status 'INACTIVE' or 'TERMINATED' are blocked from all leave operations.

BR-007 — Active Policy Constraint: A LeaveRequest may only reference a LeavePolicy where isActive = true. If a policy is deactivated (INACTIVE), existing approved requests under it remain valid, but no new requests may be created or submitted.
BR-009 — Date Range Validity: For any LeaveRequest, startDate must be on or before endDate. Both dates must be valid. A zero-length request (startDate = endDate) is permitted as a single-day leave.

BR-010 — Minimum Notice Period: When a LeaveRequest transitions from DRAFT to SUBMITTED, if the associated LeavePolicy.minimumNoticeDays is set, the startDate must be at least that many calendar days in the future. Emergency leave (leaveType = 'emergency') bypasses this check.

BR-008 — No Overlapping Approved Leave: An employee may not have two APPROVED LeaveRequests whose date ranges overlap. The system must check for overlaps before approving any request. Overlap is defined as any shared calendar day between two date ranges. DRAFT, REJECTED, and CANCELLED requests are excluded from overlap checks.
domain_notes:
Lifecycle states introduced across entities:

**LeaveRequest** — DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED. Transitions: DRAFT→SUBMITTED, DRAFT→CANCELLED, SUBMITTED→APPROVED, SUBMITTED→REJECTED, SUBMITTED→CANCELLED (withdrawal), APPROVED→CANCELLED (revocation). APPROVED and REJECTED are terminal unless revoked.

**LeaveBalance** — ACTIVE, EXHAUSTED, FROZEN, CLOSED. Transitions: ACTIVE→EXHAUSTED (remainingDays hits 0), EXHAUSTED→ACTIVE (days restored via revocation), ACTIVE→FROZEN (employee inactive or policy deactivated), FROZEN→ACTIVE (employee reactivated), ACTIVE→CLOSED (fiscal year end), CLOSED is terminal.

**LeavePolicy** — ACTIVE, INACTIVE. Transitions: ACTIVE→INACTIVE (policy disabled), INACTIVE→ACTIVE (policy re-enabled).

**Employee** — ACTIVE, INACTIVE, TERMINATED. Transitions: ACTIVE→INACTIVE (suspension/extended leave), INACTIVE→ACTIVE (reinstatement), ACTIVE→TERMINATED (employment ends), INACTIVE→TERMINATED. TERMINATED is terminal.

**LeaveType** and **LeaveStatus** are enumerations with no lifecycle.

**AuditLog** is immutable — no lifecycle states.
